title: Patmos emulator hangs when starting a core thread on a CPU with index >= 8 in a 16-core config

fix_commits.messageHeadline: Support up to 16 cores in the emulator
Support up to 16 cores in the emulator (#111)

comments.body: That is an artifact of flattening arrays in the generated Verilog/C code. We need to manually enumerate the cores in ```Patmos-harness.cpp```. And that enumeration is hardcoded to 8 cores. Feel free to copy that code to extend it to 16 cores and make a pull request.

> That is an artifact of flattening arrays in the generated Verilog/C code. We need to manually enumerate the cores in `Patmos-harness.cpp`. And that enumeration is hardcoded to 8 cores. Feel free to copy that code to extend it to 16 cores and make a pull request.

Thanks for pointing me to this, I extended the code to support 16 cores and created a pull request. Also added a warning in case someone wants to use even more cores.
